integrity: The complete proof includes an exact polynomial Euclidean certificate and a standalone deterministic Python/SymPy verifier. Computation is over exact finite fields, with no extrapolation or undocumented external data.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns the marked constant-one two-parameter Picard family in characteristic thirteen and the finite zero-rank coefficient scheme, not geometric isomorphism classes or the complete Newton polygon. Possible equivalent unindexed earlier computations remain a priority risk; a relevant 1991 article was abstract-accessible but not available in full.
title: Thirty-six reduced zero-\(13\)-rank Picard parameters and their Frobenius splitting
